# hpe_morpheus_subnet (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Subnet resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_subnet" "example" {
  type_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type_id` (Number) The type ID of the subnet.

### Optional

- `config` (Map of String) Configuration map for the subnet.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels for the subnet.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the subnet.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is active.
- `cidr` (String) The CIDR of the subnet.
- `dhcp_server` (Boolean) Whether DHCP server is enabled.
- `gateway` (String) The gateway of the subnet.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the subnet.
- `name` (String) The name of the subnet.
- `netmask` (String) The netmask of the subnet.
- `subnet_address` (String) The subnet address.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_subnet.example 123
```
